archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-03.5 Perform Quality Evaluation and Versioning
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Finally, after all editing, correction, and enrichment, the dataset undergoes a quality evaluation. This step checks whether the actions taken have improved data accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Teams compare pre- and post-editing quality metrics to confirm that known issues have been resolved. Documentation is updated, and a new version of the dataset is created — fully traceable and ready for use in estimation or modeling. This versioned dataset becomes the organization’s official edited dataset, forming the trusted baseline for statistical computation.
Value created: Verified, high-quality dataset with clear lineage and confidence in its reliability.
